activity.title: Activity
activity.range_custom: Period: pick the first and the last day
activity.range_too_long: A period can be at most {days} days long.
activity.footnote: One square is 15 minutes ({timezone}). The approximate time counts quarters with any activity; it is not logged working time.
activity.load_error: Activity could not be loaded. Please try again later.

disabled.title: Activity is turned off
disabled.description: A project admin can turn it on in project settings → Features → Activity.
disabled.no_access: Only project admins and members can see the activity of this project.

settings.title: Activity
settings.description: A heatmap of when work happens in this project: one square per 15 minutes, a darker colour for more actions. Data are also available through the API.
settings.toggle_description: Shows Activity in the project navigation. Actions are recorded either way, so turning it on later shows the past too.
settings.kinds_description: Pick the actions that count as activity. The choice also applies to past actions.
settings.save_error: The setting could not be saved. Please try again.
settings.report_description: The report on the Activity page counts real time from series of actions, not from quarter-hours. The grid keeps showing quarters.
settings.series_gap_description: Actions closer than this join one series (1–120).
settings.series_padding_description: A series lasts from its first to its last action plus this time, so a single action counts this long (0–60, not more than the gap).

issue.cycle_module: Added to a cycle or module

issue.created: A new work item in the project.
issue.state: Moving a work item to another state.
issue.property: Name, assignees, priority, labels, dates, estimate or parent.
issue.description: Changes to the description of a work item.
issue.comment: Adding, editing or deleting a comment.
issue.link: Adding or removing a link or an attachment.
issue.relation: Blocking, related, duplicate and other relations.
issue.cycle_module: Adding a work item to a cycle or module, or removing it.
issue.archive: Archiving, restoring or deleting a work item.
issue.intake: Work items coming in through Intake.

page.created: A new page in the project.
page.edited: Editing page content, at most once a minute per person and page.
page.renamed: Changing the title of a page.
page.archive: Archiving, restoring or deleting a page.

view.changed: Creating or editing a view of this project.

log.entry: Notes of what people and AI agents did, added on the Activity page or through the API. An entry fills every quarter of its time range.

log.text_placeholder: For example: fixed the redirect after sign-in and deployed it to staging.
log.save_error: Couldn't save the entry. Try again.
log.delete_confirm: The entry will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
log.delete_error: Couldn't delete the entry. Try again.
log.empty_title: No log entries in this range
log.empty_description: Log entries say what was done and when. Add them here, or let AI agents write them through the API or the plane-log script.

report.download_error: The report could not be downloaded. Please try again.
report.describe_grid: Time from series of actions, not from quarter-hours: actions less than {gap} min apart form a series that lasts from the first to the last action plus {padding} min, so a single action counts {padding} min.
report.describe_log: Time from work log entries; an entry without an end counts {open} min.
report.describe_mixed: Result (work log + actions outside the log): the time covered by a log entry or by a series of actions, counted once. Actions outside log entries add to it, also those of AI agents (for example work items created at night).
report.describe_union: The project time counts the time anyone worked; parallel work counts once.
report.describe_skipped: Skipped periods are left out of every source; an entry or a series counts only outside them.

summaries.description: A few sentences on what happened in the project on a day, one per day and person. AI agents write them through the API or plane-log.
summaries.text_placeholder: For example: the login fix is deployed; the backup review continues tomorrow.
summaries.replaces: You already have a summary of this day; saving replaces it.
summaries.save_error: Couldn't save the summary. Try again.
summaries.delete_confirm: The summary will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
summaries.delete_error: Couldn't delete the summary. Try again.
summaries.empty_title: No day summaries in this range
summaries.empty_description: Write what happened on a day in a few sentences, or let AI agents do it with plane-log summary add.
summaries.read_error: Couldn't check your summary of this day, so saving is blocked. Pick the date again or try later.

skipped.title: Skipped periods
skipped.description: Periods the time report leaves out, for example a night of automated tests. The grid hatches them but keeps counting. Times in {timezone}.
skipped.description_placeholder: For example: night of automated tests
skipped.save_error: Couldn't save the period. Try again.
skipped.delete_confirm: The period will count in reports again.
skipped.delete_error: Couldn't delete the period. Try again.
skipped.in_grid: Skipped period: left out of the report

unread.title: New
unread.description: Work items created by others in your projects that you have not opened yet.
unread.load_error: Could not load new work items.
unread.empty_description: You have opened every work item others created in your projects.

mark_all.title: Mark all as read?
mark_all.confirm: {count, plural, one {# new work item} other {# new work items}} in all projects will no longer be new.
mark_all.confirm_filtered: {count, plural, one {# new work item} other {# new work items}} in the selected projects will no longer be new.
mark_all.done: {count, plural, one {# work item marked as read} other {# work items marked as read}}
mark_all.error: Could not mark the work items as read.

push.heading: Push notifications
push.description: A system notification about new work items others create in the projects you choose. Turn them on in every browser where you want them.
push.unavailable: Push notifications are not available on this server.

browser.title: This browser
browser.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
browser.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings, then reload the page.
browser.off: Notifications are off in this browser.
browser.on: Notifications are on in this browser.

errors.enable: Could not turn on notifications in this browser.
errors.disable: Could not turn off notifications in this browser.
errors.test: Could not send a test notification.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.incomplete: The list is incomplete: the first {count} decisions were loaded. Narrow it with filters or tell the coordinator.

no_access.title: No access
no_access.description: Project decisions are visible to project admins and members.

disabled.title: Decisions are not turned on in this project
disabled.description: A project admin turns them on in the project settings, under Features.

error.title: Could not load the decisions
error.description: Check the connection and try again.

settings.title: Decisions
settings.description: The register of decisions the project keeps to: one decision is one rule with a number, a state and a history of changes. Agents record and read them with plane-decision; here you can review and change them.
settings.toggle_description: Shows “Decisions” in the project navigation and opens the register to project admins and members. When turned off, the decisions stay in the database, but nobody reads or changes them.
settings.load_error: Could not load the decision settings.

search.too_short: Type at least {min} characters to search the text; a decision or work item number works at once.
search.has_more: Showing the newest results; narrow the phrase to see the rest.
search.error: Search is not working; try again in a moment.
search.other_states: {count, plural, one {# more result in other states.} other {# more results in other states.}}

card.issue_hidden: You have no access to this work item

queues.label: Queues
queues.rollout_info: The project coordinator sees these changes in their inbox (plane-decision inbox), carries them into the rules and the code, then checks them off.

change.title: New wording of the decision
change.hint: The new version is in force at once. The old one stays in the chain of versions as superseded, and the project coordinator sees the change in their inbox and carries it into the rules and the code.
change.hint_split: Each new decision is a rule of its own and in force at once. The old one stays in the chain as superseded by all of them, and the project coordinator sees the change in their inbox.
change.hint_accept: The proposal is accepted in this wording as your decision and goes to the project coordinator's inbox.

dialogs.condition_placeholder: e.g. when returns exceed 20 a month
dialogs.date_or_condition: Give a date or a condition.

defer.title: Defer {number}
defer.description: The decision is not in force until the date or until the condition is met. The project coordinator sees this in their inbox.

review.title: Review {number}
review.description: The decision stays as it is. Give the date of the next review, or leave both fields empty if no further review is needed.

postpone.title: Move the return of {number}
postpone.description: The decision stays deferred; only the date or the condition of its return changes.

revoke.title: Revoke {number}?
revoke.description: The decision stops being in force and nothing replaces it. The project coordinator sees this in their inbox.

reject.title: Reject the proposal {number}?
reject.description: The proposal does not come into force and stays in the register as revoked.

import_fix.title: Correct {number}
import_fix.description: Correct what the import estimated or did not know. Once saved, the decision leaves the queue “To review after import”.
import_fix.author: Who decided
import_fix.author_required: The author is unknown: choose who decided.
import_fix.deferred_hint: Set the date or condition of the return afterwards with “Move the return”.

errors.title: Could not save the change
errors.invalid_transition: This action is not possible in the current state of the decision. Reload the page: someone may have just changed it.
errors.already_superseded: This decision is already superseded. Change its new version instead.
errors.not_needs_review: This decision no longer waits for a review after import.
errors.validation_error: Check the fields of the form: one has a wrong value or is too long.

map.count: {decisions, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}} in {areas, plural, one {# area} other {# areas}}

legend.attention: waiting for you or for a rollout

map.hint: Hover a decision to highlight its links; click it to open it.
map.narrow: Links show on a wider screen; click a decision to open it.
map.focus_lines: Only the lines of the pointed decision
